title: ItemMigrationDef
description:
An item migration definition from JSON type `"MIGRATION"`.

Defines how to migrate old item IDs to new ones when the game data changes.

content.description: Content items to migrate (e.g. container contents).

id.description: The old item identifier(s) to migrate from (can be a single string or array of strings).

replace.description: The new item identifier to replace with.

variant.description: Additional field used in MIGRATION definitions (e.g. variant).
